title: Mangrove Loss Slowed 45%, But Coasts Already Paid
hook: Mangrove loss slowed 45%, after coastlines lost a natural shield.
closing: Slower destruction helps, but lost mangroves still leave coastal communities exposed.
question: Can mangrove protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove forest area shrank by 3.6 million hectares. Coastlines lost part of their natural storm barrier.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves. It carried the largest regional loss shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed 45%. Protection is reducing destruction, even before it stops completely.
